summary: Deterministic Quick Dev identity projections for plan toolchain-workflow-repair; slices W0-W6; excludes logs/ and plan/resume state files; validates repository-relative non-symlink paths and marks missing files absent; loads implementation contract and rejects invalid/missing slices; candidate manifest derives allowed changes plus planned new files, normalizes tools paths, deduplicates and sorts; dependency identities include candidate hashes; identity includes candidate, contract, registry, authority inputs, validator inputs, closure definition, and file hashes; validator version toolchain-workflow-repair.validate-all.v1; exposes per-slice and aggregate validation snapshots; path escape, wildcard, invalid slice, contract, symlink conditions are rejection cases
